learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will learn the best daily habits to keep our minds happy and our bodies super strong!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Good hygiene means keeping our body clean to stay away from germs. Brushing our teeth twice a day, taking a bath, and washing our hands before eating are superhero habits!
Exercise makes our muscles strong and keeps our heart happy. Playing outdoor games like tag, cycling, or doing yoga are fun ways to exercise.
Posture is the way we hold our body when we sit, stand, or walk. Keeping our back straight helps our bones grow perfectly and stops our neck from hurting.
After a long day of playing and learning, our brain and body need rest. Sleeping for 8 to 10 hours every night gives us fresh energy for the next morning!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Healthy Habit Tracker!
fun_activity.instructions: Make a chart on a paper with three columns: Brushing, Playing Outside, and Sleeping Early. Put a happy face sticker or draw a star next to each one you finish today!

quick_recap: ⭐ Cleanliness keeps dangerous germs away from us.
⭐ Playing outside and exercising makes our muscles very strong.
⭐ A good posture keeps our bones healthy.
⭐ Lots of sleep is the secret to waking up happy and full of energy.
